visualCharacteristics.purpose: Bento-style mosaic of mixed-size promotional tiles: one tall feature tile beside a stack of smaller supporting tiles

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile; each row has an optional image-only cell (tile media/illustration) and a content cell (heading, short text, CTA button and/or link). The first row is the tall feature tile

reuseGuidance: Use for 2-5 mixed-size promo tiles where one tile dominates. For equal-size cards use a cards block; for a single image/text pair use a columns block. Options: mirrored puts the feature tile on the right, alt makes all tiles equal, light/orange-light are colour hooks.
